title: ML prior-art extract record
description: ONE admitted ML artifact, deep-read: a model, a dataset or a benchmark. A paper is never a record -- an artifact's paper travels on its row in `provenance`, which is why that block is required on every kind.

item_id.description: SEVEN prefixes, frozen-but-extensible: adding one later is legal, removing one is not. The record's filename DERIVES from this id — `HF-`, `HFD-` and `DOI-` ids essentially always carry a slash, so the derivation is the common case here, not a corner.

as_of.description: The point in time the FACT was true. NEVER the write time.

found_by.description: The angles that admitted this artifact, comma-joined. A SEQUENCE serialized to one line because every spawn param is a string.

skipped.description: Present iff `outcome: skipped`. A relevance bail STILL WRITES the record — a queue row that produced no file is indistinguishable from a spawn that never ran.

authority.description: The band of the source this record was READ from, strongest first.

capability_tags.description: Validated against the project's `capability-map.yaml` by the synthesis child's first deterministic check — the portable gate cannot see the project's scope files.

score.description: The quality filter, RANKING ONLY and never a cut. The sole cut is the relevance bail above; a `discard` verdict in the register is a synthesis judgement about fit, not a filter on the corpus.

provenance.description: REQUIRED on every kind, all three keys present and explicitly null where absent. The 1:1 artifact-per-record unit rests on this block: a paper is not a record, and without somewhere for it to land a literature hit has no home but a row of its own.

model.description: The `model` payload. Field names are BORROWED where a standard supplies one, and each borrowing is named: `task` is HF's `pipeline_tag` vocabulary verbatim; `library_name`, `base_model`, `base_model_relation` and the licence fields are HF model-card metadata; `downloads`, `likes` and `last_modified` are the Hub API's `downloads`/`likes`/`lastModified`; `results[]` is HF eval-results + `model-index`; `considerations` is CycloneDX 1.6 `modelCard.considerations`; `governance` is the SPDX 3.0.1 AI profile. The rest are ours, because nothing supplies them.

task.description: HF `pipeline_tag`, VERBATIM. Not a paraphrase: the join with the Hub is what this field is for.

license_id.description: The card's own licence id, as it is written there.

license_use_restrictions.description: What the licence FORBIDS, in the licence's own words. L3 groups on this across models AND datasets, and a restriction disqualifies regardless of `score`.

params_reported.description: As the source states it. Never normalised to a number: `7B`, `7 billion` and `6.74e9` are three different statements and only the source's own is evidence.

artifact_formats.description: safetensors, gguf, onnx — what is actually downloadable.

benchmark_id.description: A `BENCH-` id, resolving to a benchmark record where one was extracted. L2 judges whether it measures OUR capability.

value.description: The source's own words. NEVER converted, rounded or recomputed — L5 forbids it downstream and the record is where that starts.

reported_by.description: The quality filter's evaluation-transparency signal, and rung 2 of the adoption ladder requires `third-party`.

harness.description: OURS, because no standard carries harness identity — HF folds it into free-text notes. An eval whose harness is unnamed is not reproducible.

results.description: At most ten, because this is evidence rather than a leaderboard mirror.

serving.description: OURS. A measured serving figure, with who measured it — L4 rolls these into a collective envelope.

cost.description: OURS. A price with no date cannot be placed, so `as_of` is required whenever the block is present at all.

governance.description: SPDX 3.0.1 AI profile. L6 reads it, and ONLY when angle b2 ran.

dataset.description: The `dataset` payload, grounded in Croissant/RAI and the SPDX Dataset profile. WHERE `croissant_present` IS TRUE THE FIELDS BELOW ARE READ, NOT AUTHORED: `provenance` from `rai:dataCollection`/`rai:dataCollectionType` + SPDX `dataCollectionProcess`; `annotation` from `rai:dataAnnotationProtocol`/`rai:dataAnnotationPlatform`/`rai:annotationsPerItem`; `known_bias`/`limitations`/`intended_use_cases` from `rai:dataBiases`/`rai:dataLimitations`/`rai:dataUseCases` + SPDX `knownBias`/`intendedUse`; `pii_or_consent_noted` from `rai:personalSensitiveInformation` + SPDX `hasSensitivePersonalInformation`. `name`/`description` are schema.org `Dataset`; `size_reported`/`rows`/`modality` are the SPDX Dataset profile; `splits_defined` is Croissant `cr:Split`.

license_use_restrictions.description: L3 crosses models AND datasets: a permissive model fine-tuned on a non-commercial dataset is not permissive downstream.

croissant_present.description: HF emits a Croissant record for every Hub dataset, so its ABSENCE is itself a signal the quality filter counts.

datasheet_present.description: Presence only — Datasheets for Datasets is a prose standard with no machine form to validate.

provenance_block.description: The dataset's OWN collection provenance, distinct from the record-level `provenance` every kind carries.

annotation.description: Protocol, platform and annotators-per-item — the single best predictor of label quality, which is why all three are carried rather than a summary.

pii_or_consent_noted.description: THREE states. A boolean would assert `no PII` wherever the truth is that the card does not say.

benchmark.description: The `benchmark` payload. THE GROUNDING IS THIN HERE AND THIS SCHEMA SAYS SO: only HF eval-results and `model-index` are externally specified and alive; MLPerf specifies a filesystem contract rather than a record schema; HELM and lm-evaluation-harness are conventional only; BIG-bench is archived. `harness` and `harness_version` are OURS precisely because harness identity is what no standard carries.

id.description: The minted slug. The pattern FORBIDS `--`, because a slug carrying it would hand `record_filename`'s identity branch the one input its anti-fixed-point guard exists to catch — and this is a schema pattern rather than a prose convention for exactly that reason.

what_it_measures.description: L2 judges the delta between this and OUR capability. A benchmark whose subject is unstated cannot be judged valid or invalid.

contamination_noted.description: L2 names this state explicitly. `unstated` is a finding about the benchmark, not a blank.

vendor_independent.description: Independence from the vendors it ranks — a quality-filter signal a leaderboard rank can never supply.
